conditions: The two operations are the stated release and acquire on the same atomic object, and the acquire reads from the specified release sequence in the draft's model.
limitations: The source-specific read relation is required. Numeric equality alone, consume operations, fences, and processor implementations have separate rules.
Scope is the exact N3220 C2y working draft. Published ISO text and observed implementation behavior require separate evidence.

triggers: Correction of the draft or passage, exact bytes drift, contrary primary evidence, or a superseding edition requiring a separate claim.

statement: WG14 draft N3220 describes an atomic release operation as synchronizing with an atomic acquire operation on the same object when the acquire reads a value written by a side effect in the release sequence headed by that release.
